findings.title: Forged bytecode in a git-ignored __pycache__ runs inside the verifier and is not detected
findings.summary: _dirty_input_errors skips every path containing __pycache__ and every *.pyc. Python loads an unchecked-hash .pyc without comparing it to the source, so a forged scripts/governance/__pycache__/iiac_common.cpython-312.pyc replaces the committed verifier module while the source file, git status and the byte comparison all stay clean.
findings.reproduction: raw3/t2_pyc_plant.txt. Clone of 2e0ed9c6b (canonical class): compile source plus payload with py_compile (UNCHECKED_HASH) into the cache path. (1) payload writes a marker file: marker created, A codes still exactly the two A-18, git status empty. (2) payload prints 'EVOL-X closure preflight: PASS' and exits 0: --gate formal-closure returns PASS, exit 0 on the canonical clone with B-4/B-5/P3 open and git status empty. Removing the pyc restores FAIL, exit 1.
findings.impact: Same access class as W402-01 (write access to the checkout, here to an ignored directory) yet a total bypass: any imported verifier module can be replaced silently, so every gate result can be forged. The round-3 claim that the verifier code is bound to HEAD is false for the code that actually executes.
findings.required_correction: Run the verifier with bytecode caching disabled and caches ignored (sys.dont_write_bytecode, -B, PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX in a temp dir, or hash-checked loading), refuse any __pycache__ below scripts/ or the imported package paths, and stop skipping .pyc in the dirty check.

findings.title: Remaining unbound free-text channels in the evidence tree
findings.summary: Accepted by Gate A: a committed addendum file inside operator_decisions/, b6_acceptance/ or b4_reaudit/; a whole new directory carrying its own EVIDENCE_INDEX.json beside the known ones; extra free-text keys inside closure_evidence items of an operator-kind resolution (the closed fixture still reaches Gate A and Gate B PASS); a gitlink entry inside audit/.
findings.reproduction: raw3/r3_atk7b.txt (T6a, T7 x3, T7b, T8). Rejected, for contrast: addendum at the evidence root (V-g), unindexed addendum in audit/ (V-g2), any new file or gitlink in certification/ (T6b).
findings.impact: Nothing consumes these values; descriptive channels only. Gate-consumed scope remains sealed.
findings.required_correction: Allow-list file names per evidence directory, require every file of an indexed directory to be indexed and consumed, validate closure_evidence item keys.

findings.title: Binding of all of scripts/ rejects unrelated local files; preflight runtime grew
findings.summary: Any modified tracked or untracked file under scripts/ (editor temp file, scratch script, unrelated edit under scripts/dev) fails both gates with A-21/B-12 although it is not a verifier input; files elsewhere (README, tests/, docs outside the evidence root) are correctly ignored. Reading every file below scripts/ and the evidence root makes a canonical run take 76 s on an idle machine (2 min 39 s under load).
findings.impact: Fail-closed usability cost; operators must run the preflight from a clean scripts/ tree.
findings.required_correction: Bind the actual import closure of the verifier (loaded module files) instead of the whole tree.

findings.title: Not exercised: forged commit-graph, GIT_DIR/GIT_INDEX_FILE, git calls of imported IIAC modules
findings.summary: The imported activation gate and iiac_common run their own git subprocesses without core.commitGraph=false / core.fsmonitor=false (replace objects are covered by the process-wide environment variable). Redirecting environment variables other than the six listed are not refused. None of these was tried.
